name: Tempester 1.6.3.0-c — per-pad play probability (test)
description: 1.6.2.0 plus n°36: each pad of each beat has a play probability (0-100 %, default 100 = 1.6.2.0 bit for bit). The sequencer skips a note of that pad with probability 100 - p (an LCG mixed with the core timer, drawn only when p < 100); a skipped note is never queued, so no voice and no MIDI note-on. Set with MIDI CC 14 = p in percent (101-127 = 100) on the Remote Pad IN channel, for the selected pad of the beat being edited; kept in the beat (pad block word 5 = 100 - p, written 0 by the stock OS) in beat and project files and in the SysEx 5F / 5C n; reset by Init Beat. No screen shows it. No version-digit patch: the machine still displays 1.6.2.0. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
